description: Before reading on-chain history through a free public RPC, ask which endpoints on that chain answered GL1TCH's latest history checks correctly. Some free endpoints return an empty, successful answer for data that exists ("silent empty"), which makes code conclude "no activity". Measured every 6 h on Solana, Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and Polygon.

chain.description: solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum or polygon

depth.description: How far back you need to read (endpoints that didn't serve it are left out)

name: rpc_truth
title: RPC Truth: which free RPC endpoints answer history honestly
